behavior.rotations: Covers starting seats 0, 1, 2 and 3, each followed by the next physical seat.
behavior.endPhase: Moves three existing physical cards from the active owner's Deck to hand to create a seven-card End Phase; the owner must discard to six before the incoming seat draws.
behavior.ownerAuthorization: The inactive partner has no legal discard action and cannot call stepTagDuel for the active owner's discard.
behavior.persistence: JSON round-trip during discard preserves the active physical owner and private hands.
behavior.drawOrdering: The incoming seat's top Deck UID is untouched until the outgoing owner completes discard, then is drawn exactly once.
behavior.mainPhase: A seven-card hand during Main Phase does not expose early discard actions for any of the four starting seats.
behavior.conservation: All 80 physical UIDs and card identities remain conserved; non-acting hands and Deck orders remain unchanged.
